collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-35  -  THE ELDER'S UNFINISHED STORY SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: An elder begins recounting an old village custom but admits that some details have been forgotten.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An elder begins recounting an old village custom but admits that some details have been forgotten.

choices.label: Record Only What the Elder Remembers Confidently.
Ask Other Elders What They Remember.
Invite Younger Villagers to Ask Questions.
Preserve Several Versions of the Story.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The elder recalls another detail after seeing the written notes.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Their accounts overlap in some places and differ in others.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: No one remembers the missing detail, and the uncertainty remains part of the record.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A child's question prompts a thoughtful discussion about how traditions change.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The elder cannot answer every question but enjoys the children's curiosity.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The scholars keep the differing accounts for future generations to examine.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Some villagers prefer one version, but the others are not discarded.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The account preserves useful history without pretending to be complete.
